details:
I've been attempting to generate imposters for one of my public avatars I recently updated. However I keep getting the message 'Oh no! We tried, but we could not generate an impostor version of the avatar...' For reference, the avatar had an update around February, then May. I deleted the old imposters and tried to create new ones to reflect the changes, which is when I ran into problems.

As a test I detached the blueprint ID and reuploaded a test avatar. The 'new' avatar generated imposters without issues. The avatars are exactly the same in the SDK.

Public avatar ID: avtr_ab1819c1-1f09-426a-be20-f28722826e9e

Test avatar ID: avtr_8819a7a4-6a2b-40cc-9563-c7b587df4960

Some things I've already tried

- Logging out and relogging in to generate imposters

- Reuploading the avatar from the SDK

- Duplicating the avatar in the SDK and reuploading

- Privating the avatar and attempting to regenerate the imposters

- Privating the avatar, reuploading, waiting for security checks, trying to regenerate imposters

To note:

- Rig is set to humanoid

- Using the latest stable SDK version 3.8.0

- No issues in the console

- Logged in as the creator/owner of the avatar

Any help is much appreciated.
title: Cannot generate imposters
